manager.label: r2modman (ReturnOfModding)
notes: Reads r2modman's own profile folders. Nothing is moved or changed - the mods stay where r2modman put them and this app takes a copy.
Each r2modman profile is listed separately, so importing 'Default' and 'Hardcore' gives you two sets you can put in different sandboxes.

r2modman names its game folders itself (the internalFolderName in its ecosystem list). If a game is missing here, drop a corrected descriptor in the app's plugins/manager folder - the folder name is the only thing that needs to change.
One descriptor id per mod loader, because a descriptor has a single in-profile mods path.
Descriptor for games that use ReturnOfModding: its mods live in ReturnOfModding/plugins inside each profile.
